reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} no longer works. Please enter the current password.

reimport_history.name: Reimport consumption history
reimport_history.description: Re-fetches monthly usage history from ista for all meters and recomputes Home Assistant's long-term statistics. No new login required - reuses the already stored token. Useful after an integration update that fixes history calculations, or after a physical meter replacement.
